messages:
mike_cs: Heads up — seeing a cluster of support tickets asking for a "per-workspace usage export" feature. SD-4321, SD-4330, SD-4334 all similar. Can we pick a canonical request to merge into and agree owner?
anya_pm: thanks — saw those. Agree we should merge. Can you paste the ticket threads so I can draft acceptance criteria? :+1:
mike_cs: quick snippets: SD-4321: asks CSV export by date range for finance. SD-4330: wants API endpoint for programmatic pull. SD-4334: customer asks for webhook on daily aggregates.
jordan_eng: sounds like three surface requirements: CSV/UI export, API endpoint, and webhook. Could be 1 epic with 3 stories. What's the priority from sales?
kevin_support: priority varies — SD-4321 (enterprise) is high, SD-4330 (mid-market) medium, SD-4334 (pilot) low. Sales asked for update to all three requesters.
anya_pm: plan: I'll create a canonical backlog item (PROD-298) that unifies the asks. We'll tag child tickets as duplicates and list explicit acceptance criteria per sub-feature.
triage-bot: Automated note: SD-4330 flagged as possible duplicate of SD-4321 by text-similarity (score 0.83). Suggest merging metadata and adding "duplicate-of: SD-4321" tag.
mike_cs: can we also standardize the tagging? I propose tags: duplicate-of:<canonical>, needs-requirements, impact:customer-size.
jordan_eng: fine. For engineering estimates we need: expected QPS for API, CSV retention limits, webhook retry semantics. I'll add a checklist to PROD-298.
anya_pm: I'll own outreach. Template reply to requesters: "Thanks — we're consolidating similar requests under PROD-298. We'll provide ETA and scope after requirements. If you need a faster workaround, ping support for an export." Want to add anything?
kevin_support: add a line offering a manual export while we scope it. Most customers accept that.
mike_cs: agreed. Also flag any customer who needs SLA or regulatory export — escalate to legal/compliance.
anya_pm: next steps: 1) I create PROD-298 and link SD-4321/30/34 by EOD. 2) Tag tickets with duplicate-of and needs-requirements. 3) Jordan to draft initial estimate by Thu. 4) Mike/Kevin to send templated update.
jordan_eng: will aim for Thu. If we need to split into two sprints we should call out minimal viable piece (CSV export + manual API) vs webhook as follow-up.
mike_cs: perfect. once PROD-298 exists I'll mark SD-4321 as canonical and close duplicates with links.
anya_pm: thanks team. I'll post the PROD-298 link here when done. :wave:
